text:
Sam: Quick q — Steam Deck charger died on commute. Anyone bringing a spare USB-C PD I can borrow at the mezz tonight? :grimacing:
Anya: I can bring a 45W PD brick and a short USB-C cable. Not the fastest but should top you up enough for a session.
Mike: I have a 65W GaN that works fine, but only one USB-C to C. Happy to share if we do power-strip roulette. :powerplug:
Devon: Heads up — the mezz only has two usable outlets near the couch now (plant takeover). Might be worth bringing a small power strip.
Taylor: I’ll grab a 6ft surge strip and some cable ties. Would help if we label chargers so they don’t walk off.
Sam: Legend, thanks. If anyone has a power bank with PD out (60W+) that’d be better than mid-session tethering.
Anya: I have a ~60W bank but it’s lent out atm. Pro tip: leave a little duct tape with initials. Worked last time.
Mike: We should do a tiny sign-up so we don’t end up with 5 controllers and 0 chargers. Who’s bringing games? I’ll bring Rocket League and Smash.
Devon: I’ll bring the HDMI switch + projector adapter. Also I made a tiny label template:```Name - item (eg. Taylor - 6ft strip)```
Taylor: Can somebody add a sticky note to the main whiteboard with meetup time? I’m on baby duty till 7:15, will be there by 7:45.
OfficeBot: Reminder: mezzanine quiet hours start at 10pm; please keep speakers reasonable after that.
Sam: Perfect — 7:45 meet at mezz couch, power strip + GaN = game on. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
